reason: Verify every applicable frontend quality check and referenced rule was followed
Audit primitive reuse, hierarchy, interaction states, locales, focus, and accessible controls
Audit ownership boundaries and reject unnecessary global components or duplicate abstractions
Audit subscriptions, effect dependencies, cleanup, stable callbacks, and hidden mounted-workspace behavior
Audit latest-selection-wins, no stale Session data, state restoration, and authoritative ownership
Audit continuous diff, independent large-file loading, and read-only Inspector constraints
Audit route/state exhaustiveness, boundary schemas, nullability, and absence of unsafe casts
Audit real Electron evidence at both viewports, themes, locales, motion, keyboard, and accessibility
Check for duplicated status, selection, picker, settings, and detail-stack ownership
Trace any Main/preload changes end to end and reject UI inference where a source contract is required
Compare the result against confirmed release-worktree failures and preserved visual-language evidence
